name: Monitor Kernel Dispatch
implementation_notes: Mirrors MonitorSolidWasteDisposalView.vue's structural pattern (breadcrumb + hamburger header, draft/pause list, New Data/Load Data/Back footer) but with EVENT-LOG summary semantics: 'Hari Ini' shows Jumlah Kernel Dispatch + Jumlah Kejadian Tercatat (not a tipping-progress metric), plus a 'Kejadian Terakhir' card (getLastEventSummary()) showing the single most-recently-logged event across ALL of the user's records (not scoped to today), displaying destination/buyer + event date + vehicle plate no instead of Solid Waste Disposal's type/date/vehicle triple

localSchema.ts gained 2 new tables (kernel_dispatch_record, kernel_dispatch_detail) via CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS — no column-migration function needed since these are brand-new tables, not an existing-table schema change
router/index.ts gained 3 new routes: monitor-kernel-dispatch, kernel-dispatch-form, data-preview-kernel-dispatch

StationListView.vue's draftStatusByType wiring updated: 'kernel-dispatch' now calls kernelDispatchRecordRepo.getDrafts(userId).length > 0 instead of the previous hardcoded false placeholder — MONITOR_ROUTE_NAMES already had 'monitor-kernel-dispatch' mapped from an earlier station-list update, so the tile itself needed no further changes. Test file updated with a matching mock (getKernelDispatchDraftsMock) plus a default mockResolvedValue([]) added alongside every existing processWater default, following the exact convention used for Process Water/Solid Waste Disposal

kernelDispatchRecordRepo.ts is a new, from-scratch repo file (no pre-existing block to extend) — createDraft()/getTodaySummary()/getLastEventSummary()/getDrafts()/getAllRecords()/getDraftWithDetails()/saveDraft()/pauseDraftWithFormData()/deleteDraft() all written together, with 21 detail columns (more than Solid Waste Disposal's 17) per entity-catalog kernel-dispatch-detail

REVISI 2026-10-03: spec Playwright mobile/tests/e2e/monitor-kernel-dispatch.spec.ts ditulis (12 test) dan lulus dalam run penuh suite Playwright mobile (727 lulus / 0 gagal, 65 spec). Penulisan spec ini menemukan cacat aplikasi: todayDateString() di mobile/src/services/kernelDispatchRecordRepo.ts memakai new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) (UTC) untuk kolom date pada createDraft, sehingga draft yang dibuat pukul 00:00–06:59 WIB mendapat tanggal kemarin — hilang dari kartu 'Hari Ini' Monitor, tersembunyi oleh filter default hari ini di Data Preview, terkirim ke server dengan tanggal kejadian yang salah (dan dinilai kunci periode pada hari yang salah). Kini memakai tanggal lokal (getFullYear/getMonth/getDate), selaras dengan view Data Preview dan getTodaySummary (date('now','localtime')). Uji regresi: vitest 'mengisi tanggal draft dengan tanggal lokal, bukan UTC (dini hari WIB)' di mobile/tests/kernelDispatchRecordRepo.spec.ts (merah sebelum perbaikan, hijau sesudahnya) dan uji e2e 'New Data dini hari ...' di monitor-kernel-dispatch.spec.ts (sebelumnya fixme, kini lulus).

known_issues.description: Unit test coverage % not measured — no Xdebug/PCOV in this environment, consistent with prior stations in this codebase.
